configurations.name: backend
configurations._comment: autoPort must stay false: frontend/vite.config.js proxies /api to a hardcoded http://localhost:8000, so a reassigned port leaves the UI unable to reach the API. AUDIOSENSE_USERS is blanked deliberately: configuring accounts beats the anonymous opt-out (services/auth.anonymous_allowed), so on any machine that has a gitignored backend/.env this entry served a login screen instead of the no-login dev server it is meant to be. A real environment variable wins over the .env file, and an empty one means no accounts. Use the 'backend-protected' entry to exercise the login.

configurations.name: backend-protected
configurations._comment: Credentials come from the gitignored backend/.env. autoPort must stay false — see the 'backend' entry above.
